summary: I'm an electro-mechanical engineer and a leader specializing in product development, manufacturing and industrial automation, as well as someone who's quick to pick up, apply, and integrate new technologies into real-world systems. I unite mechanical design, electronics, controls, software, and manufacturing to develop reliable, practical products and systems built for real-world use. That same curiosity extends beyond my professional work into traveling the world, rebuilding cars, replicating movie props and finding creative ways to automate the repetitive parts of my everyday life. RileyBeenders.com is another extension of that curiosity. I built it to house my experience and projects, apply to ambitious opportunities, and show the full range of what I can offer.
